name: Shapla
summary: Multi-product SaaS suite spanning HR management, tax filing, virtual office and a job portal.
description: Shapla is a versatile business platform offering HR management apps, tax filing tools, virtual office space and a job portal in one integrated ecosystem. I contributed across backend services, Vue-based interfaces and containerized deployments powering the shapla.io platform.
highlights: Multi-service architecture behind a Kong API gateway
Dockerized deployment across the full stack
Polyglot backend combining Laravel, Go and Python services

name: Northwest Driving School
summary: Booking, scheduling and student management platform for a US-based driving school.
description: A production web application powering day-to-day operations for Northwest Driving School — student onboarding, lesson scheduling, instructor coordination and administrative workflows on a Laravel + Vue stack.
highlights: End-to-end student and instructor scheduling workflows
Dockerized production deployment behind NGINX
PostgreSQL data model tuned for reporting and reservations

name: XTC Exotics
summary: E-commerce and fleet management platform for a US-based exotic vehicle marketplace.
description: XTC Exotics is a specialty automotive platform that combines online catalog browsing with backend fleet and inventory operations. Built with Laravel + Vue, PostgreSQL and Docker for reliable production hosting.
highlights: Catalog, inventory and fleet management in one platform
Vue-driven customer experience over a Laravel API
Containerized deployment with NGINX reverse proxy

name: Manage Your Ecommerce
summary: Cross-platform ecommerce operations tool integrating multiple sales channels.
description: Manage Your Ecommerce is an operations dashboard that helps online sellers coordinate inventory, orders and analytics across sales channels. Built on Laravel and Vue with Flask microservices and a MySQL data layer.
highlights: Hybrid Laravel + Flask backend for operational and analytical workloads
Vue.js dashboard with cross-channel order visibility
Fully dockerized deployment

name: Inventory Keeper
summary: Inventory and stock management platform for small and mid-sized businesses.
description: Inventory Keeper is a straightforward, reliable inventory system that lets SMBs track stock, purchases and sales without heavyweight ERP overhead. Built on Laravel + Bootstrap with a MySQL backend.
highlights: Purpose-built for small and mid-sized retail operations
Server-rendered Laravel + Bootstrap UI for reliability on low-end hardware

name: Attendance Keeper
summary: Attendance management platform with a web dashboard and companion mobile experience.
description: Attendance Keeper handles staff and student attendance tracking with reporting, exports and role-based access. Laravel + Bootstrap on the server, React on the interactive front-end, MySQL for storage.
highlights: Role-based dashboards for admins, managers and staff
React front-end embedded in a Laravel-served application

name: Attendance Keeper Desktop
summary: Electron-based desktop client for Attendance Keeper.
description: A cross-platform desktop companion to the Attendance Keeper web app, built with Electron so on-site attendance workflows keep running even with intermittent connectivity.
highlights: Cross-platform Electron desktop client
Companion to the Attendance Keeper web platform

name: PDF OCR
summary: Document processing service that extracts structured text from PDF uploads.
description: A Flask-based OCR pipeline with a Vue.js front-end for uploading PDFs and receiving structured, searchable text output. Deployed with Docker behind NGINX on a PostgreSQL data store.
highlights: Async OCR pipeline in Python
Vue.js upload/preview interface
Containerized deployment
